scope: New acceptance runner entry points only; complements historical leaf audit. Integrity is not execution or production acceptance. Labels are the union of implemented modes; actual selected per-check reports take precedence.

runners.scope: Isolated UI interactions and persisted effects; optional native devices, capture, model and external skill execution.
modes: --models: actual UI assignment, isolated settings restart and independently observed real upstream model request; provider-reported alias retained separately
--providers: actual UI provider create/edit/delete with isolated persisted files, credential preservation and process restart; no service-execution claim
--provider-probe: UI-triggered real external model-list retrieval, not inference acceptance
--model-import: real UI import/export, private round-trip preservation, invalid batch rejection and killed-writer startup recovery
--external-plugins: actual executable MCP package lifecycle and UI chat tool effect
--plugin-crash (requires --external-plugins; REAL_OS): owned process kill, rendered unavailable status and actual effect after UI restart

runners.scope: Actual duration/capture/OCR/resource measurements; optional local GGUF. Short runs never prove 24 hours; overall resource coverage remains partial.
Native desktop fixture capture, OCR, change detection and reopened observation memory; not continuous endurance.
Owned host real-model/tool crash recovery, retries and failure outcomes; not arbitrary side-effect compensation.
Owned isolated host and historical phase11 assertions; controlled connector fixtures are not external service execution.
Actual downloaded executable MCP plugin handlers, manager persistence, refresh, preparation-failure preservation, process kill/restart and file effects; UI covered separately.
Pinned GitHub skill executes actual model/tools and independent Chrome artifact interactions.
modes: --resume-directory DIR: existing artifact recheck only, not new execution

runners.scope: Controlled visible native screen changes and local GGUF inference persisted in encrypted observations.
Actual local GGUF generation, rendered color recognition, owned-process resources, cancellation and restart.
Actual observed title transition through configured rule to native screen-size action; not every OS event source.
Real point-in-time capture/native/OCR process counters; not whole-duration resource acceptance.
Read-only original row-content comparison against a specified actual backup; clock fields explicitly scoped.
Windows synthesized prompt to actual STT, configured model and TTS; not human spoken conversation.
modes: --devices: actual microphone frames and output playback; audibility/barge-in remain unverified
